## Checklist

<!-- Tick what applies. See CONTRIBUTING.md for details. -->

- [ ] `npm run check:ssrf` passes (if URL fetching changed)
- [ ] `npm run check:ai` passes (if prompts, schemas or `src/lib/ai.ts` changed)
- [ ] Generated content stays grounded in the selected sources, with citations
- [ ] `README.md`, `docs/` and `.env.example` are updated for any new feature, setting or environment variable
- [ ] No `.env*` files (other than `.env.example`), `.data/`, keys, cookies or real user documents are committed
